# Support

This is a personal fork. It has no support entitlement and no guaranteed response time, and it is not a support channel for PiG or Pi.

The repository issue tracker is for the owner's reproducible defects, feature requests and documentation problems. Search existing issues first and include the version, operating system, installation method, expected result, actual result and a minimal reproduction. Do not include credentials, tokens, private configuration, customer data or undisclosed vulnerabilities.

Report vulnerabilities privately through [`.github/SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md). Report conduct incidents through [`.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
